title: Chaos Dice
description: Chaos Dice that brings chaos to the world when opened
body:
Chaos Dice – Test Your Fate!

Are you ready to take a gamble? Chaos Dice is a high-stakes, risk-versus-reward mod built specifically for NeoForge. It introduces a single, incredibly powerful artifact into your Minecraft world: the Chaos Dice. If you are looking to add a layer of unpredictable excitement, thrilling loot drops, and dangerous consequences to your survival experience, this mod is exactly what you need!

🌟 What does this mod add?

At its core, this mod adds the Chaos Dice, a craftable mystical item. When you activate the dice, it doesn't just instantly drop items into your inventory. Instead, it spawns as a magical, levitating entity in the world, building suspense before revealing your fate.

🎲 Features & Mechanics: The Six Categories

Once the dice finishes rolling, it will select a random outcome from six distinct categories based on a sophisticated weight system. What will you get?

  • 🟢 Common, Rare, & Very Rare: Useful everyday survival items, resources, and standard loot to help you on your journey.
  • 🟣 Epic & Legendary: Incredibly rare and powerful treasures, high-tier gear, and ultimate rewards that make the gamble worth it.
  • 🔴 Negative (The Curse): Beware! Not every roll is a winner. You might trigger dangerous effects or bad luck to balance out the powerful rewards.

⚒️ Crafting the Artifact

To begin your journey into chaos, you must assemble rare materials. The ritual requires focus and wealth. Combine Lapis Lazuli, Emeralds, Gold, and a Diamond to forge the dice.

⚙️ Fully Configurable (Perfect for Modpacks!)

Are the rewards too easy? Are the curses too frequent? You have total control! The mod includes a comprehensive Config system that allows server owners and players to adjust the drop chances for every single category. You can individually tweak the weights for Common, Rare, Very Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Negative outcomes to perfectly balance the risk for your specific world.

🧩 Cross-Mod Compatibility

Chaos Dice is designed to work seamlessly with other fantastic mods. It natively supports rewards from:

Simply Swords [Fabric & Forge] by sweenuss

Artifacts by ochotonida

Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks by Iron431
